item.title: CuberShop Magnetic Speed Cubes Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys; Imported by SKY CUBE HK
item.company: Online at Amazon.com from April 2025 through June 2025 for between $20 and $25.
item.brand: Online at Amazon.com from April 2025 through June 2025 for between $20 and $25.
item.product: CuberShop Magnetic Stickerless Speed Cubes, model YJ MGC 5×5
item.summary: This recall involves CuberShop's Magnetic Stickerless Speed Cubes, model YJ MGC 5×5. The products are a handheld 5×5 mechanical puzzle cubes that consists of interlocking plastic pieces. The Speed Cubes have six colored sides and the "MGC" logo printed on the center of the cubes. The Speed Cubes come in a box with "MGC" and "5x5" printed on the sides of the box. The product's packaging included spare magnets that were packaged separately in a sealed plastic bag.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: CuberShop Magnetic Stickerless Speed Cubes, model YJ MGC 5×5.
item.remedy: Consumers should take the recalled loose magnets away from children, stop using them immediately, and contact SKY CUBE HK for information on how to receive a $5 refund. Consumers will be asked to throw away the magnets and email a photo of the disposed magnets to recall@cubershop.com. Consumers may keep the cube.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
